confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain and assume a July peak-season rate including Czech VAT and city tax. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the local beer price relationship. The FX observation came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page or the F11 table to verify it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Czech regional and mid-sized Central European cities such as Olomouc and Plzen, with Brno hotel and hostel pricing set below Prague and above smaller regional towns given its trade-fair and university demand.
